summary: Biondo Contracting is an owner-run residential roofing and siding contractor (roof replacement and repair, flat roofs, VELUX skylights, flashing, ventilation, siding) that has operated since 1990 out of Monroe Township and serves Central New Jersey including East Brunswick. Its Google Business Profile ('Biondo Contracting-Roofing Specialists') shows 4.9 stars, a Monroe office address and phone (732) 257-2926, but the website field still points at biondoroofing.com, which today serves an unstyled Thai-language slot-game/Google-Play clone instead of the roofing site. Intake is now phone-only: the brand domain, its WPForms quote form and its services pages are all gone, so every web lead from search and maps dies at the front door.

facts.fact: Google Business Profile is titled 'Biondo Contracting-Roofing Specialists', category Roofing contractor, rated 4.9, at 38 Spotswood Ave, Monroe Township, NJ 08831, phone (732) 257-2926, shown as 'Open · Closes 12 AM', with biondoroofing.com as its website link (review count not visible in the limited Maps view).

As of 2026-11-13 the brand domain serves no roofing content at all: desktop (1280 px) and phone (390 px) loads of biondoroofing.com render a Thai-language slot-game page titled สล็อตโรม่าทดลอง that mimics a Google Play listing, with zero business information, phone number or navigation.

Verisign RDAP shows biondoroofing.com was registered 2010-12-07, expires 2030-12-07, is registrar-locked at GoDaddy (clientTransferProhibited etc.) and was last changed 2025-12-08 — the registration is current and controlled, so the loss of the site is a hosting/CMS compromise, not an expired domain.

An Internet Archive capture from 2026-04-20 still shows the normal roofing homepage, so the site was serving legitimate content roughly seven months ago; that page states the firm has specialised in NJ roof installations, repairs, skylight replacement, flashing, ventilation and siding since 1990 and publishes state license 13VH01287400.

Archived site markup declares foundingDate 1990-04-16, numberOfEmployees 8, contact info@biondoroofing.com and +17322572926, an areaServed list running Monroe Township, East Brunswick, Old Bridge, Somerset, Manalapan, Edison, Milltown, North/South Brunswick, Kendall Park, Monmouth Junction, Dayton, Piscataway and Sayreville, and opening hours of 00:00-23:59 seven days a week.

Birdeye company profile: 4.7 stars from 172 reviews, listed at 163 Fresh Ponds Rd., East Brunswick, NJ 08816, hours Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-7:30 p.m., Sat 9:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m., closed Sunday, marked as claimed by the owner.

Archived 'free estimate' page shows how prospects used to convert: a WPForms contact block under 'CONTACT US TODAY', plus 'Open 24/7' and a town-by-town service-area list covering Middlesex, Monmouth and Union/Essex county towns (Monroe, East Brunswick, Old Bridge, Edison, Spotswood, Woodbridge, Freehold, Middletown and others).

ProvenExpert profile (active since 07/15/2025) repeats: in business since 1990, 'over 35 years' serving Central NJ, services list (new roof installation, repair, skylight, flashing, flat roofing, siding), address 38 Spotswood Avenue, Monroe Township NJ 08831, and links its website to biondoroofing.com.
Customer reviews on the Birdeye profile credit 'Sam' / 'Sam Biondo' as the owner who personally inspects roofs and runs the crews; site schema credits page authorship to Samuel Biondo.

A minimal Webflow-hosted page titled 'Biondo Contracting' exists at biondo-contracting.webflow.io with a one-paragraph brand description (licensed NJ roofing company, serving Central NJ since 1990, in-house team) and a link back to biondoroofing.com, with no navigation, services pages or form.

operations_signals: Quote and booking path is now a single channel: call (732) 257-2926 from the Google profile; there is no reachable form, email capture or booking flow because the domain serves spam (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Biondo+Contracting+Roofing+Specialists+Monroe+Township+NJ)

Before the compromise, intake ran through a WPForms contact block on the homepage and on a dedicated 'free roofing or siding estimate' page, plus a published email info@biondoroofing.com (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/free-roofing-or-siding-estimate-new-jersey/)

Hours are contradictory across sources: Google profile says open until midnight, archived site schema claims 24/7 (00:00-23:59 every day), the archived estimate page says 'Open 24/7', while Birdeye lists Mon-Fri 8:30-7:30, Sat 9-4:30, Sun closed — a caller cannot tell when anyone answers (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

Service area is broad and town-by-town: Middlesex County core (Monroe, East Brunswick, Old Bridge, Edison, Milltown, Spotswood, Sayreville, Woodbridge) plus Monmouth and Union/Essex towns, i.e. long drive times between jobs (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/free-roofing-or-siding-estimate-new-jersey/)

Repair and post-install callback work appears in reviews (leak re-checks, damaged shingle fixed the next day, plywood replaced at no charge), implying ongoing small-job scheduling alongside full replacements (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

Two conflicting business addresses are in circulation: 38 Spotswood Ave, Monroe Township (Google, site schema, ProvenExpert) and 163 Fresh Ponds Rd, East Brunswick (Birdeye) (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)
review_themes: Speed and tidiness dominate the praise: roofs torn off and replaced in one to two days, debris and nails cleaned up, neighbours' property protected, crew described as 10 men (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

Pricing praised as fair and transparent — repeated 'no hidden fees' comments, one reviewer noting plywood replaced free despite a contract fee, others saying the price was neither cheapest nor high (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

Owner-led service is the differentiator reviewers name: Sam does the inspection himself, shows up on the job, answers quickly, and is described as the only contractor who actually went on the roof (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

A minority complaint alleges work was not stood behind after payment ('once money was in hand never returned call') and questions whether uniformly five-star ratings are incentivised — one reviewer, not a pattern (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051?page=9)

Rating split across sources: 4.9 on Google versus 4.7 from 172 reviews on Birdeye, suggesting a long tail of less-than-perfect experiences concentrated off Google (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)
tech_footprint: The website was WordPress with All in One SEO Pro 4.8.1.1, WP Rocket plus RocketCDN, Beaver Builder, Google Site Kit/MonsterInsights GA4 (G-5KVCK2CN03) and WPForms for lead capture (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/)

A third-party script from assets.usestyle.ai with id 'seona-js' was loaded on every page, i.e. the Seona AI content/SEO plugin — consistent with the large library of keyword blog posts on the old site (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/)

Social/owned channels linked from site schema: facebook.com/NJRoofers, twitter.com/biondoroofing, instagram.com/biondo.contracting, pinterest.com/expertnjroofers, a YouTube channel and a LinkedIn profile (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/)

No chat widget, booking widget, customer portal or CRM signal found on any reachable surface; the only live owned property today is the Google Business Profile, whose website link is poisoned (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Biondo+Contracting+Roofing+Specialists+Monroe+Township+NJ)
A bare Webflow staging page with brand copy exists but publishes no services, hours, phone, form or schema — either an unfinished rebuild or a parked demo (https://biondo-contracting.webflow.io/)
growth_signals: Longevity and manufacturer positioning: in business since 1990 (35+ years), certified with Owens Corning, CertainTeed and GAF, and marketed as using its own employees rather than subcontractors (https://web.archive.org/web/20260420032126/https://biondoroofing.com/)

Service line has widened beyond shingles to flat/low-slope membrane roofs, skylights, seamless gutters, siding, windows and shutters, per archived pages and reviews (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

Review volume is substantial for a crew-sized firm — 172 reviews on Birdeye and a 4.9 Google rating — indicating steady completed-job throughput (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051)

The firm kept its listings fresh after the site broke: ProvenExpert profile activated 07/15/2025 and still pointing at the old domain, and the Google profile remains active with current hours (https://www.provenexpert.com/en-us/biondo-contracting/)
physical_signals: Office address per Google profile, site schema and ProvenExpert: 38 Spotswood Ave, Monroe Township, NJ 08831; a second address, 163 Fresh Ponds Rd, East Brunswick, NJ 08816, is what Birdeye publishes (https://www.provenexpert.com/en-us/biondo-contracting/)

Company size self-declared in site schema as 8 employees, while customers describe a crew of about 10 on tear-off/re-roof jobs — a small owner-operated outfit with job-site crews rather than a large fleet operation (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/)

Work is residential: shingle tear-offs (two layers at a time), low-slope bitumen membrane flat roofs, VELUX skylights, flashing around chimneys/HVAC, gutters; no commercial or multi-unit portfolio is described (https://web.archive.org/web/20260420032126/https://biondoroofing.com/)

Service footprint spans dozens of towns from Monroe/East Brunswick east to the shore (Freehold, Wall, Toms River, Brick, Point Pleasant) and north to Westfield/Summit, so drive time between jobs is a real constraint (https://web.archive.org/web/20250518163153/https://biondoroofing.com/free-roofing-or-siding-estimate-new-jersey/)
decision_maker: Sam (Samuel) Biondo, owner — named as the owner throughout customer reviews on the business's Birdeye profile and credited as author in the site's schema metadata (https://birdeye.com/biondo-contracting-east-brunswick-nj-149586765701051); BBB principal record could not be opened (Cloudflare challenge)

inferences.inference: The domain was never lost to an expiry squatter: the WordPress site itself was compromised or replaced on the same registration.
inferences.reasoning: RDAP shows the registration created 2010 and paid through 2030-12-07 with client-lock statuses at GoDaddy, while the archived homepage was normal on 2026-04-20 and the current HTML is a Thai slot-game clone. An expired-and-reregistered domain would show a recent creation date.

inferences.inference: The highest-value loss is not aesthetics but inbound lead flow: every Google Maps or search click on the brand name now lands on gambling spam, so the 4.9-star profile's traffic converts to nothing.
inferences.reasoning: Google profile website field = biondoroofing.com; the live page contains no phone, address or roofing copy at 1280 px or 390 px. With 172 reviews on Birdeye the profile is clearly receiving volume, and there is no other web intake channel.

inferences.inference: A phone-only intake at this size probably means missed calls during tear-off days, when the owner is on a roof and no one is at a desk.
inferences.reasoning: Schema declares 8 employees; reviews describe the owner personally inspecting and being on site all day; hours are advertised as 24/7/midnight on some surfaces and 8:30-7:30 on another, so no published promise of live answering exists. No answering service, chat or booking tool is visible.

inferences.inference: Much of the old site's content was AI-generated SEO copy, so it will need rewriting rather than restoring.
inferences.reasoning: The archived pages carry the Seona/usestyle.ai content plugin and read in the repetitive, list-heavy style those tools produce (e.g. 'Sequentially... Consequentially... Importantly...').

inferences.inference: A replacement site may already be in someone's hands, but nothing has shipped.
inferences.reasoning: A Webflow page carrying the brand name and copy exists but has a single paragraph, no navigation, no form and no schema, and links back to the compromised domain — consistent with an unfinished rebuild rather than a live site.

inferences.inference: Demand is seasonal, so the intake gap costs most in spring through autumn.
inferences.reasoning: The business is residential roof replacement in New Jersey; the archived blog includes warm-weather installation advice, and reviews cluster around tear-offs and storm-related leak calls. No published booking calendar exists to confirm volume by month.
